summary: iter457 The Workshop Floor knowledge-hub refactor — verified backend + frontend against the live preview. BACKEND (17/17 pytest pass in test_iter457_workshop_floor.py, junitxml: iter119.xml): (1) GET /api/community/forum/categories returns exactly the 10 expected ids {marketplace, getting-started, woodworking, laser, plasma-metal, 3d-printing, handmade-crafts, design-software, selling, community} — each has label + blurb + tags[] (non-empty) + thread_count(int); total across categories > 0. (2) GET /api/community/overview returns the full shape — trending_discussions<=5, featured_projects<=4, latest_videos, latest_journal<=3, popular_files<=4, trending_tags[{tag,count}], stats{members, threads, replies, projects, design_files, new_members_30d} all ints, coming_soon length == 4. (3) Filters — ?category=woodworking returns only category==woodworking rows; ?tag=cnc-router returns only threads whose tags[] contains 'cnc-router'; legacy alias ?tag=general correctly maps to category=='community'. (4) Tag follows — /community/tags/following without token → 403; POST /community/tags/cnc-router/follow (buyer JWT) → {ok:true, following:true}; GET following lists it; /community/forum-feed/followed returns cnc-router threads; DELETE unfollows; POST /community/tags/not-a-real-tag/follow → 400. (5) POST /community/forum (buyer JWT) with {category:'laser', tags:['diode','material-settings','invalid-tag']} → created thread has category=='laser' and tags=={'diode','material-settings'} (invalid-tag dropped). Legacy category 'machine-help' → 'community'. Unknown category → 400. Two test threads inserted and DELETED by title-match cleanup (verified deleted count in db.forum_threads). (6) Migration admin endpoints — /admin/forum/migration-report and /admin/forum/migrate both return 401/403 without admin JWT. With admin JWT: latest report has counts{total,high,medium,low_fallback,review,skipped_already_migrated>=70}, by_category dict populated. Non-force /admin/forum/migrate call returned counts.total==0 and counts.skipped_already_migrated>=70 (idempotent — nothing left to process). Did NOT run with force=true. (7) Migration data integrity — direct MongoDB probe: 74 forum_threads have legacy_category, tags[], and migration_confidence set; forum_replies count == 222 (unchanged); sampled thread doc preserved created_at, user_name, reply_count. FRONTEND (100% surfaces verified — screenshots saved): (a) /community defaults to Overview tab — data-testid=workshop-floor-overview visible, overview-featured-maker shows 'Iron & Oak Studio' (7 days left), overview-stats bar renders (774 members / 74 discussions / 222 replies / 23 projects / 113 design files), overview-trending-discussions shows 5 overview-thread-* rows, overview-trending-tags renders 10 overview-tag-* chips, overview-coming-soon strip visible with 4 items. action_items: No defects. The 41-thread conservative fallback to community/general-discussion is documented as expected behavior — safe by design.
Minor observation (not a bug): the /admin/ops landing shows a 'PROD OUTAGE /test-outage HTTP 502' banner — pre-existing synthetic monitor, unrelated to this refactor (mentioned in review request).
critical_code_review_comments: workshop_floor.py classify_thread (L132-170): scoring logic is deterministic and conservative — a top_score<2 correctly falls back to community/general-discussion, and confidence tiers (high>=6, review on tie, else medium) look reasonable. LGTM.

workshop_floor.py migrate_forum (L175-221): defaults to skipping already-migrated threads (query filters by absence of legacy_category) and preserves the original category as legacy_category. Idempotent by construction. When a thread has a legacy value already in WORKSHOP_CATEGORY_IDS and no legacy_category tag, it keeps its current category — good for new-taxonomy threads that predate the report.
workshop_floor.py follow_tag (L243-252): correctly rejects unknown tags with 400 (using the _TAG_RE regex + membership check), uses $setOnInsert with upsert so idempotent — no dupes possible. Good.

community_forum.py list_threads (L101-116): the legacy ?tag=<category-id> alias is subtle but well-guarded (only maps when the tag string is a known category id in FORUM_CATEGORY_IDS or LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAP); genuine tag values fall through to a tags[] contains query. Verified end-to-end.

community_forum.py create_thread (L131-173): tags are normalized (lowercase, dedup via dict.fromkeys), filtered to CATEGORY_TAGS[cat] whitelist, clipped to 5, and the AI moderator failure is fail-open with an exception log — safe pattern.
Small cleanliness nit: `doc['tag'] = cat` is written on thread creation (L165) alongside `doc['category']` — appears to be legacy schema compatibility. Not a bug, just noting.

WorkshopFloorTab.jsx surfaces Run Migration + a Force checkbox in one place — should probably require an explicit confirm() before firing force=true given how destructive it can be. Current UI does show the checkbox unchecked by default, so risk is low, but a confirm dialog would harden it.

CommunityPage.jsx (~3987 lines) is getting close to the 700-line limit called out in the code-review guidelines. Would benefit from a split into ForumTab.jsx / OverviewTab.jsx / FilesTab.jsx modules — non-blocking, but worth planning.
